package org.apache.curator.x.async;

import java.util.function.UnaryOperator;
import org.apache.curator.framework.CuratorFramework;
import org.apache.curator.framework.api.CuratorEvent;
import org.apache.curator.framework.api.UnhandledErrorListener;
import org.apache.curator.x.async.api.AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl;
import org.apache.curator.x.async.details.AsyncCuratorFrameworkImpl;
import org.apache.zookeeper.WatchedEvent;

/**
 * Compatibility layer for CuratorFramework.
 *
 */
public interface AsyncCuratorFramework extends AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl {
    /**
     * Wrap an existing CuratorFramework.
     *
     * @param client the client to wrap
     * @return the wrapped client
     */
    static AsyncCuratorFramework wrap(CuratorFramework client) {
        return new AsyncCuratorFrameworkImpl(client);
    }

    /**
     * Return the underlying CuratorFramework.
     *
     * @return the underlying CuratorFramework
     */
    CuratorFramework unwrap();

    /**
     * Return a new DSL with the given watch mode.
     *
     * @param mode watch mode
     * @return a new DSL with the given watch mode
     */
    AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl with(WatchMode mode);

    /**
     * Return a new DSL with the given unhandled error listener.
     *
     * @param listener unhandled error listener
     * @return a new DSL with the given unhandled error listener
     */
    AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl with(UnhandledErrorListener listener);

    /**
     * Return a new DSL with the given result filter and watcher filter.
     *
     * @param resultFilter result filter
     * @param watcherFilter watcher filter
     * @return a new DSL with the given result filter and watcher filter
     */
    AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl with(
            UnaryOperator<CuratorEvent> resultFilter,
            UnaryOperator<WatchedEvent> watcherFilter);

    /**
     * Return a new DSL with the given unhandled error listener, result filter and watcher filter.
     *
     * @param listener unhandled error listener
     * @param resultFilter result filter
     * @param watcherFilter watcher filter
     * @return a new DSL with the given unhandled error listener, result filter and watcher filter
     */
    AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl with(
            UnhandledErrorListener listener,
            UnaryOperator<CuratorEvent> resultFilter,
            UnaryOperator<WatchedEvent> watcherFilter);

    /**
     * Return a new DSL with the given watch mode, unhandled error listener, result filter and watcher filter.
     *
     * @param mode watch mode
     * @param listener unhandled error listener
     * @param resultFilter result filter
     * @param watcherFilter watcher filter
     * @return a new DSL with the given watch mode, unhandled error listener, result filter and watcher filter
     */
    AsyncCuratorFrameworkDsl with(
            WatchMode mode,
            UnhandledErrorListener listener,
            UnaryOperator<CuratorEvent> resultFilter,
            UnaryOperator<WatchedEvent> watcherFilter);
}
